rows.text: Methodology: criteria, weights, thresholds and calculations (v4, 2026-11-03; v3 rules unchanged except the new rankable type)
Yellow cells are editable inputs. Score formulas reference them by defined name. Rule status: ORIGINAL = carried from v2; PROPOSED = new in v3; REPLACED = v2 rule retired.
Parameter | Defined name | Value | Rule status | Explanation
Check date (all freshness and deadline tests) | CheckDate | 2026-11-03 | PROPOSED | Date used for the route-live gate, evidence freshness and overdue actions. Change it to re-run as of another date.
A: Contract / access opportunity weights (sum 100)

A1 Rent-paying role | wA1 | 20 | PROPOSED | 4 = verified tenant/lessee; 3 = inferred lessee from contract or landlord scheme; 2 = guaranteed-rent product advertised, entity role unconfirmed; 1 = managing agent or referral; 0 = not a rent payer.

A2 Current intake in target geography | wA2 | 20 | PROPOSED | 4 = written current sourcing in the target towns; 3 = current sourcing at region level; 2 = live contract covers region but intake unconfirmed; 1 = limited or one sub-area; 0 = paused or excluded.

A3 Funded contract behind route | wA3 | 15 | PROPOSED | 4 = awarded contract verified and route funded by it with volumes; 3 = awarded contract verified; 2 = framework membership only (not an award); 1 = programme or policy signal; 0 = none.

A4 Committed term net of breaks and contract linkage | wA4 | 15 | PROPOSED | 4 = 10+ yrs without tenant break; 3 = 5-10 yrs, or 3-5 yrs aligned to funding; 2 = 3-5 yrs that may outlast funding or break unknown; 1 = documented tenant break or under 3 yrs; 0 = nightly or short stay. Moved here from covenant to avoid double counting.

A5 Cost transfer (voids, repairs, utilities) | wA5 | 10 | PROPOSED | 4 = full repairing, no voids, utilities and CT paid; 3 = no voids, day-to-day repairs and damage covered; 2 = as 3 but landlord keeps major items (roof, boilers, kitchens); 1 = partial; 0 = landlord bears voids.

A6 Rent vs LHA benchmark | wA6 | 10 | PROPOSED | 4 = evidenced rent at or above 110% of LHA; 3 = 100-110%; 2 = 90-100% or stated as LHA-to-market; 1 = 60-90%; 0 = below 60%. LHA is a proxy, not open-market rent.
A7 Scale (units sought or contract scale) | wA7 | 5 | PROPOSED | 4 = 100+ units; 3 = 25-99; 2 = 10-24; 1 = under 10; blank = unknown.
A8 Access route | wA8 | 5 | PROPOSED | 4 = published landlord route with named team; 3 = form or existing relationship; 2 = generic inbox; 1 = phone or general only; 0 = none.
B: Counterparty financial strength of the SIGNING entity (sum 100)
B1 Entity matched to registry | wB1 | 10 | PROPOSED | 4 = company, charity or RSH number confirmed; 2 = ambiguous between entities; 0 = not identifiable.

B2 Accounts recency and type | wB2 | 15 | PROPOSED | 4 = full audited, period end within 18 months; 3 = full, 18-24 months; 2 = small or total exemption; 1 = unaudited abridged or older than 24 months; 0 = overdue.
B3 Scale (revenue, £m) | wB3 | 15 | PROPOSED | Computed from revenue where entered: at or above B3_t4 = 4, B3_t3 = 3, B3_t2 = 2, B3_t1 = 1, else 0.

B4 Profitability (margin on stated measure) | wB4 | 25 | PROPOSED | Computed where figures entered: margin at or above B4_m4 = 4; 0 to B4_m4 = 2; loss = 0. Measure (PBT or operating) is shown in Counterparty_Financials.

B5 Liquidity and reserves | wB5 | 25 | PROPOSED | Analyst rating: 4 = net cash and strong net assets; 3 = positive net assets, adequate liquidity; 1 = negative free reserves or tight liquidity; 0 = net liabilities.
B6 Regulatory viability (RSH) | wB6 | 10 | PROPOSED | V1 = 4, V2 = 3, V3 = 1, V4 = 0. NA where the entity is not graded (removed from denominator).

Rankable row types (only these enter the contract ranking)
Direct lessee
Commissioner - direct leasing
Provider / framework appointee

Other row types: Intermediary / route; Commissioner - programme; Windfall / market signal; Supply; Placeholder. Windfall and Supply rows keep the original 0-10 overlay and get a separate overlay rank.
CALCULATIONS
Rating scale | Every criterion is rated 0-4 (integer). Blank = unknown. "NA" = not applicable (removed from numerator and denominator).
Known-weighted score | Score = 100 x SUMPRODUCT(weights, ratings) / (4 x known weight). Unknowns are excluded, not scored 0 and not scored as a pass.
Coverage | Coverage = known weight / applicable weight (applicable excludes NA). Shown in its own column.
Low / high bounds | Low bound treats unknowns as 0; high bound treats unknowns as 4. Shows how far the score could move once gaps are filled.
Coverage cap | Score is capped by coverage band (Cov1/Cov2/Cov3 and Cap2/Cap3/Cap4) so sparse rows cannot top the ranking.

B used | B is looked up from Counterparty_Financials by counterparty key (the SIGNING entity). Parent figures are context only unless a parent guarantee is evidenced (none is). If B has no coverage, Bdefault is used.

Pursuit index | wPA x A_capped + wPB x B_used, then capped at QualCap if any gate is UNKNOWN. A prioritisation index for research and outreach; not a probability, credit approval or investment recommendation.

Gates (applied before ranking) | G-Geo: target geography served. G-Route: computed from route end date vs CheckDate (expired = FAIL; no date = UNKNOWN) unless the override column is filled. G-Elig: Laurito/Mack can access the route. G-Req: requirement compatible with the Laurito/Mack product (residential stock on leases). G-Role: counterparty pays rent. Any FAIL = Excluded (confirmed fail). Any UNKNOWN = Qualify (capped). N/A ignored.

Status logic | Placeholder: Excluded: placeholder. Any FAIL: Excluded: confirmed fail (lists the gates). Non-rankable type: Not ranked. A coverage below MinCovA: Research needed. Any UNKNOWN: Qualify: n unknown gate(s). Otherwise Eligible.

Rank and tie-break | Ranked rows only (rankable type, no FAIL, A coverage at or above MinCovA). Order: rank tier (Eligible before Qualify when TierRank = 1), then pursuit index (rounded to 0.1) desc, then E (0.1) desc, then B used (0.1) desc, then Opp ID ascending. COUNTIFS gives every row a unique rank. Tested in Test_Cases (T-06/T-07 tie broken on ID; T-08 wins on E).
E score | E = 100 x (wE1 x combined A+B coverage + wE2 x source tier / 4 + wE3 x freshness / 4). Bands: High at or above E_hi, Medium at or above E_med, else Low.

Double counting avoided | Contract term and break risk sits only in A4 (v2 counted it under both covenant and term). Counterparty strength sits only in B. Relationship is not scored except as access (A8). Framework ceiling values are not scored as revenue; A3 separates award from membership.

Property C and D | C = known-weighted fit vs the matched Demand_Register requirement. D uses GIY (gross, not NIY), capex intensity and an estimated NIY only where costs are entered. Property E uses price basis (Achieved 4, Offer agreed 3, Asking or Guide 1), rent basis (Verified 4, Rent card 3, LHA proxy 2, Assumed 0) and units basis (Existing 4, Proposed 1). Property gate: type or beds incompatible, or matched requirement paused = FAIL.
AUDIT OF THE ORIGINAL (v2) SCORING
v2 rule (REPLACED) | Core score /100 values were hard-coded seed totals. Score Breakdown dimension columns, dimension total and variance were blank, so no score could be reproduced from its parts.
v2 rule (REPLACED) | One 100-point score mixed route/demand, economics, covenant and engagement, so contract access, partner credit and property attractiveness shared an unexplained number.
v2 rule (REPLACED) | Evidence completeness = (PASS + CONDITIONAL) / 10 gates, so CONDITIONAL counted as evidence; rows with 0% completeness (e.g. GM-004 SSG at 64) were in the Top 10.

v2 rule (REPLACED) | "Conditional, gates to close" was applied to any score of 75+ with zero PASS gates; GM-001 Mears ranked #1 (88) although Greater Manchester was not in its acquisition area list and its asylum contract does not cover the North West.
v2 rule (REPLACED) | The Top 10 excluded only FAIL rows: no geography gate, no expired-route gate, and framework membership was treated as demand.
v2 rule (ORIGINAL, kept) | Windfall overlay OV1-OV5 (0-10) kept unchanged for windfall and supply rows and ranked separately in Priority_Ranking.
v2 rule (ORIGINAL, kept) | Original seed rank, core score and classification are kept in Opportunity_Scoring for comparison.
